title: Characters and rigging
summary: How you build and rig characters: height and proportions, A- or T-pose, skeleton naming and size, how weights are painted, edge loops round the body and face, garments over the body, rigid gear on bones and face shape keys.

request.brief: Submit a character you built, rigged and skinned the way you deliver it: body, clothes and gear, with its armature.
must_include: The armature and the skinned meshes
Garments as separate meshes, if you model them that way
Face shape keys, if you make them

questions.ask: Which skeleton do you rig to?
Anything about your character workflow the files can't show?
